name: scroll-area
useFor: Use ScrollArea for a fixed-height list or log inside a frame (agent runs, a thread's messages, a branch row). Give it a height or max height; add ScrollBar orientation="horizontal" for a row that scrolls sideways.
constraints: A thumb that grows on hover
Scroll areas nested in scroll areas
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its quiet and strong rules (16, 32 and 70 percent lines) applied to Base UI's scroll area
title: Scroll Area
description: A region that scrolls inside the page with a thin square bar: a 4px thumb of the field line in a 12px lane along the edge, turning to the strong line under the pointer or while it is dragged. Content past an edge fades over 24px there (fade-y; pass orientation="horizontal" for fade-x on a row).
